SourceFile
  QualifiedPackage upstream.enums
  public enum Choice<T>
    Empty
    Item(T)
    Named <named>
      payload: T
      amount: Int
    Defaults <ctor>
      payload: T
      amount: Int = <expr>
  public fun select<T>(value: Choice<T>, fallback: T, selected: T = <expr>): T
    =
      Var selected
  public fun pack<T>(value: T): Choice<T>
    =
      MethodCall Item
        Var Choice
        Var value
  public fun score<T>(value: Choice<T>, read: (T) -> Int): Int
    =
      WhenExpression
        Var value
        arm Empty
          IntLiteral 0
        arm Item(payload)
          Call read
            Var payload
        arm Named{payload, amount}
          Binary Add
            Call read
              Var payload
            Var amount
        arm Defaults{payload, amount}
          Binary Add
            Call read
              Var payload
            Var amount
  public typealias IntChoice = Choice<Int>
  public typealias TextChoice = Choice<String>
